## Opportunities to Collaborate {.section-heading}

::: {.collab-intro .headline-special}
Whether you are exploring a new business model, validating an innovation idea, building analytics capabilities, or seeking comprehensive evidence to base an important strategic decision on — we help you structure the problem, access the right methods, and translate results into practice.
:::

::: {.collab-grid}

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa flask >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Applied Research Projects]{.collab-card__title}

[We partner on clearly defined research questions related to innovation, entrepreneurship and organization — typically with measurable outcomes, structured data collection, and rigorous analysis.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa brain >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Data Science & AI Projects]{.collab-card__title}

[We support innovative challenges with data-driven methods, including machine learning, natural language processing, and experimentation.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa graduation-cap >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Company-Linked Theses]{.collab-card__title}

[We supervise theses with company partners when the topic fits our profile and offers a feasible empirical research design (e.g., existing data, interviews, surveys, experiments).]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa chalkboard-user >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Workshops & Trainings]{.collab-card__title}

[Hands-on formats for teams on topics such as startup engineering, business model innovation, experimentation, and evidence-based decision making.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa microphone >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Talks & Guest Lectures]{.collab-card__title}

[Keynotes, panels, and guest sessions for internal events, conferences, and entrepreneurship education formats.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa handshake >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Consortia & Funded Projects]{.collab-card__title}

[We join or initiate multi-partner projects (e.g., university–industry–startup collaborations) when there is a strong research contribution and an implementation pathway.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

:::


:::
:::
